title: OLL Parity
scramble: r2 B2 U2 l U2 r' U2 r U2 F2 r F2 l' B2 r2
notes: Single flipped edge pair on top layer - occurs in 50% of 4×4 solves during OLL stage
story: This parity occurs when two adjacent edge pieces are flipped during the last layer. It's impossible on 3×3 but common on 4×4 due to the center-less nature of even cubes.
description: The most common 4×4 parity case. Two edge pieces appear flipped when you reach OLL. Fix with a long algorithm before continuing with normal OLL.
